subject: issues when read genalex file in poppr

messages.author: bed7c1348ff0ff5f
messages.subject: issues when read genalex file in poppr
parts:
Dear 

When I read a genind format file by using the following command:

gen <- read.genalex("poppr_postwar.csv", ploidy=2,sep =",")

it always comes out the error:

Warning: Error in if: missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I tried many solutions but can not solve it, can I get your help to see what wrong with it? 

Thank you very much.

Best regards
Ying

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] issues when read genalex file in poppr
parts:
Hello,

You've specified the number of loci in your file, but you still need to specify the number of individuals and populations: https://grunwaldlab.github.io/poppr/articles/poppr_manual.html#intro:import:read-genalex

You can also find information in our tutorial: https://grunwaldlab.github.io/Population_Genetics_in_R/Data_Preparation.html
